description: The LOCATION_FILTER message parameter (type 0x21) in each draft the SDKs speak, as a one-parameter list: Number of Parameters, the type delta, then the value. Draft-ietf-moq-transport-22 §9.20.9 opens the value with a Location Filter Type that selects the fields after it and has no Length. Draft-ietf-moq-transport-20 §5.1.2 length-prefixes up to four fields and the number present selects the meaning. The two spellings coincide when the field count equals the type and every field is a one-byte varint; they differ for Next Object, for an open-ended absolute {0,0}, and for any field of 128 or more.
sources: filters: one of each shape in draft-22 §9.20.9 Table 6 and its draft-20 §5.1.2 spelling, plus a two-byte StartGroup derived from the encoding rules
encodeOnly: draft-20 §5.1.2 says an open-ended filter from absolute {0,0} is equivalent to unfiltered, so its draft-20 encoding is the no-filter one; draft-22 has a spelling for it
rejected: draft-22 §9.20.9 ('Any other Location Filter Type is a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION') and a value missing a field its type selects; draft-20 §5.1.2 allows at most four fields

rejected.reason: type 0x04 selects four fields; two are present
